issues.detail: The Hebrew has two names: רְחוּם (Rehum) and שִׁמְשַׁי (Shimshai). The Chinese renders Rehum as 利宏 (correct) but renders Shimshai as 希實米人, which is a name swap/error — 希實米人 is not a transliteration of Shimshai; it appears to be a different name or a misreading. The correct rendering should be something like 申示 or 示米賽.
